subject: Problem with Avicenna app
body:
Hello Hanna and Sara,

Hope you both are doing well. I am sorry to bother you again. But I have a problem.
One of the researchers (Katja Bel) tried to add a participant in the Avicenna app.
The participant was able to make an account and to download the app, however every time when the participant entered the study code she received a notification that it was not possible to be added to the study.
Is it possible to let me know how we can fix this?

Tomorrow another researcher (Linda Duteweerd) will have to add a participant and I hope that will go ok.

If I have to send this question to another department/person, please let me know.
Thank you in advance for your answer!

Best,

Mary-ann

body:

I hope all is well with you.

Thank you for reaching out, and I am sorry to hear about the difficulties you're experiencing. 

Could you please ask the participant to log out of the app and log back in. (ask them NOT to reinstall the app though). This should hopefully fix the issue. If not, please let me know. I also hope Linda Duteweerd's process goes smoothly tomorrow.

Best,
Sara

subject: Problem with Avicenna app
body:
Hi Mary-ann,

Thanks for reaching out about the ongoing issue. I’m sorry to hear it's still not working for you and the other researcher.

As a first step, if your study requires an invitation and isn't public, could you please double-check the email addresses? Please make sure the address used for the invitation matches the one your participant used to sign up. They might have used a different email or entered it incorrectly. Additionally, please check the enrollment period; sometimes participants may try to join the study after it has ended.

Please review these points to see if they resolve the issue.

If the problem persists, could you provide more details? Specific error messages, steps taken so far, and any relevant context would be helpful.

Once I have more information, I’ll do my best to help find a solution or escalate the issue accordingly.

Looking forward to your response.
Best,
Sara
